topic: SAA multi-station decay — verification of c4 patch set (ISS-2609-2612 + critical DOI/TLDR fixes)
our_argument_summary: WIN-041 (verdict: Misleading) argues the dome five-station SAA decay table is (1) the same regional signal already counted in WIN-004/005/035/037 — correlated samples of one coherent anomaly, not independent confirmations; (2) unmonitored by the dome automation (no monitor.py domain covers the five-station claim; the only SAA-decay check is single-station TTB hardcoded 77.0/77.0); (3) post-hoc (registered 2026-03-15 against data pulled 2022-2024); and (4) circular (the >=28 nT/yr threshold is a dome model input, not a derived quantity).

dome_code_analysis.calculation_pipeline: Dome page WIN-041 presents a five-station table (TDC -79.7, SHE -54.2, HER -45.3, PST -38.8, KOU -31.0 nT/yr), Source: Direct HAPI pulls 2022-2024, Registered 2026-03-15. monitor.py contains NO domain for the five-station claim — grep for TDC/Tristan/SHE/Hermanus/PST/Stanley/KOU/Kourou returns nothing. The only SAA-decay check (monitor.py lines 489-497) is single-station TTB with hardcoded predicted=77.0/observed=77.0, error_pct 0.0, pass:True, source label INTERMAGNET TTB annual means (WIN-015).

dome_code_analysis.code_discrepancies: One naming discrepancy now flagged as holes_found[0]: our text adopts the dome code comment label Tsumeb for station TTB, but TTB is Tatuoca (Belem, Brazil); Tsumeb is TSU (Namibia). The error originates in monitor.py line 489 comment (8. SAA Decay Rate (Tsumeb TTB)) — the dome author misidentifies his own data source — but our prose repeats it in our own voice.

code_analysis_tags.monitoring_evidence: Re-verified against monitor.py @ repo HEAD 4c553b5e (2026-06-06): no domain aggregates multi-station SAA data; station codes TDC/SHE/HER/PST/KOU absent from the file. The single-station TTB check at lines 489-497 belongs to the WIN-015/WIN-037 claim family per its own source label and is hardcoded 77.0/77.0 in any case.
code_analysis_tags.relabels_standard_evidence: SAA decay rates and their spatial structure are outputs of standard field models (CHAOS-7 secular variation, Finlay et al. 2020, doi:10.1186/s40623-020-01252-9 — Crossref-verified this run); published mechanism is reversed-flux-patch growth (Terra-Nova et al. 2017, doi:10.1016/j.pepi.2017.03.002 — Crossref-verified this run). The dome relabels the cause aetheric field separation while adopting observed station values.
code_analysis_tags.post_hoc_evidence: Dome page prints Registered: 2026-03-15 | Source: Direct HAPI pulls 2022-2024 on adjacent lines (full-page poll 02-wins.txt lines 444-445, 2026-06-06): the confirming data window closed ~15 months before registration.
code_analysis_tags.derives_from_dome_evidence: The dome field equation H(r)=8537*exp(-r/8619) is azimuthally symmetric and cannot produce a between-cell decay maximum; no derivation from dome parameters to the >=28 nT/yr threshold or to per-station rates exists on the page (05-model.txt line 42 simply states the threshold as a parameter).

holes_found.description: Station misidentification repeated in our own voice: detail_verdict_text paragraph 3 says the only SAA-decay domain checks a single station (Tsumeb/TTB). TTB is the IAGA code for Tatuoca (Belem, Brazil); Tsumeb (Namibia) is TSU — confirmed against the INTERMAGNET GIN service station list this run. The conflation originates in the dome monitor.py line 489 comment (8. SAA Decay Rate (Tsumeb TTB)), but our prose states the identification as fact without attribution or correction. A geomagnetics-literate reader can catch this and discount the surrounding (correct) hardcoding argument. Same mislabel propagates in WIN-037 (against INTERMAGNET Tsumeb only; SAA-core stations like Tsumeb) and possibly the new WIN-042 Tsumeb clause (next batch item).
holes_found.recommendation: Rephrase to: a single station (TTB — Tatuoca, Brazil; the dome code comment mislabels it Tsumeb). This converts an inherited error into an additional accuracy finding against the dome AI-verifiable pipeline. Decider should open a companion issue for WIN-037 wording (out of scope for this queue item).

holes_found.description: Residual from c4 hole 4 (ISS-2610, closed): the word precisely survived the patch, migrating into the Finlay clause — CHAOS-7 secular-variation maps place the fastest decline precisely in the region between the separating cells. The c4 recommendation explicitly said drop precisely. As an empirical claim about map structure it is stronger than the cited paper warrants without a figure-level citation.
holes_found.recommendation: One-word edit: delete precisely (or replace with squarely). No other change needed.

stronger_arguments.description: The dome author misidentifies his own monitoring station: monitor.py line 489 comment labels TTB as Tsumeb, but TTB is Tatuoca, Brazil — a different observatory on a different continent ~7,800 km away. For a pipeline marketed as AI-Verifiable / No trust required (08-live-power.txt lines 163-165), not knowing which observatory the sole SAA-decay check points at is a concrete accuracy hit worth one sentence in our text.

kernel_of_truth.description: The five station decay rates the dome cites are real INTERMAGNET observations of genuinely fast SAA-region secular variation (dome page table, 02-wins.txt poll lines 448-454: TDC -79.7 to KOU -31.0 nT/yr), and the spatial gradient across those stations is a real feature of the present secular-variation field (CHAOS-7 maps, Finlay et al. 2020, doi:10.1186/s40623-020-01252-9).
kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: Real data does not make five correlated samples five confirmations: the stations sample one coherent anomaly (detail_verdict_text paragraph 1, wins.json:041), the >=28 nT/yr pass threshold is the dome own model input (05-model.txt line 42), and the claim was registered 2026-03-15 against 2022-2024 data (02-wins.txt poll line 445) — post-hoc under the dome own timestamping definition.

deeper_analysis: This is a verification-class re-review of the c4 patch set. All six c4 holes were checked individually (see patch_verification.results): 5 fully fixed, 1 mostly fixed with a one-word residual. The two DOIs introduced/retained by the patches were verified via the Crossref API this run rather than trusted from the patch text — the c4 critical arose precisely because a patch introduced a wrong DOI, so DOI re-verification is the load-bearing check for this queue item. Two observations not raised as holes: (1) the bare label Domain 8 in our detail_verdict_text matches monitor.py internal numbering (line 489 comment) but collides with the dome public falsification list where Domain 8 is Lunar Magnetic Tide (08-live-power.txt line 91); since our sentence is explicitly about monitor.py domains, the reference is defensible, but if WIN-041 text is touched again, the dome live SAA Decay Rate panel is the unambiguous phrasing. (2) detail_evidence lead-in enumerates WIN-035 among the same-basis WINs but the breakdown sentence that follows does not say what WIN-035 uses (it is WMM/CHAOS-derived per its own entry); harmless, but a completionist defender could ask. Neither rises to a hole on a verification pass. The batch gate (Step 8a) was evaluated after this review: queue item 491 (WIN-042) is class verification, no verdict change, small diff, fresh c3 singleton review today — batching proceeds.
